evidence_items.locator: prepared remarks, paragraph beginning 'Finally, Meta AI usage'

receipt.public_excerpt: Finally, Meta AI usage continues to scale, with more than 700 million monthly actives.

evidence_items.explanation: In January 2025, Meta reported more than 700 million monthly actives for Meta AI, an assistant built into its apps. He counts built-in assistants such as Rufus as part of the market. On that scope, this one product alone is about ten times his roughly 74 million threshold. Meta's own definition of 'monthly actives' differs from Sensor Tower's app counts.

receipt.public_excerpt: Superdata initially included a specific player count for May 2018 - 147 million people - although this number has since been hidden from the report.

evidence_items.explanation: The 147 million figure is a May 2018 count from SuperData, two years after launch. SuperData later hid it from its report.

receipt.public_excerpt: More people played Pokémon Go in May 2018 than at any time since the game's stratospheric summer 2016 launch.

evidence_items.explanation: May 2018 is described as the highest since the 2016 launch, not as the game's all-time peak. So '147 million at its peak' is doubtful. A higher peak would only make his comparison less flattering to AI apps.

receipt.public_excerpt: Gemini, Google’s AI chatbot, had 350 million monthly active users around the globe as of March, according to internal data revealed in Google’s ongoing antitrust suit.

evidence_items.explanation: Google's internal data shows Gemini alone at 350 million monthly users two months after his period. It suggests non-ChatGPT assistant use was far above his estimate on company measures, but it falls outside January 2025.

unresolved_gaps: No independent January 2025 count of standalone non-ChatGPT AI apps outside China, on the same basis as Sensor Tower's, was found.
Meta's 700 million figure is global and uses Meta's own definition of active use. Meta does not break out how many users are outside China.
Pokémon Go's true all-time peak monthly users are not established in a primary source.
